name: Firefox Gecko iOS
subtitle: Experimental Firefox UI with Gecko engine
description: Experimental Firefox native UI shell using Reynard Gecko for page rendering. Not an official Mozilla distribution.

apps.name: Firefox Gecko (Native UI)
apps.subtitle: Firefox native UI with Gecko page rendering
apps.localizedDescription: Experimental Firefox iOS native interface rendered with Gecko through Reynard. This is the Native UI app, separate from the Reynard shell. Re-sign all embedded code, GeckoView.framework, XUL.dylib, and the helper with the same team.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 52. Mozilla's Firefox 159 app (its own UI, tab tray, menus and settings) with web pages rendered by the Reynard Gecko engine instead of WebKit. Re-sign everything, including XUL.dylib, GeckoView.framework and Reynard Helper.appex.
